title: Internal Sales / New Business Executive
description:
Internal Sales / New Business Executive

Location: Bradford, West Yorkshire

Salary: £30,000 - £35,000 basic + Bonus + Benefits

Streamline Search is working with an established and highly regarded large-format print and visual communications business that is looking to appoint an ambitious Internal Sales / New Business Executive.

Our client has built a strong reputation for delivering high-quality print and visual communication solutions to a broad range of commercial customers across the UK.

The business offers an end-to-end service, supporting customers from initial concept and technical consultation through to production, finishing and installation.

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially driven sales professional who enjoys prospecting, opening doors and developing new customer relationships.

The role will initially be predominantly office-based, focused on generating and qualifying new business opportunities through proactive outbound activity.

There is genuine scope for the successful candidate to develop into a more senior Business Development position over time, taking greater ownership of customer meetings, account development and the full sales cycle.

Package
- £30,000 - £35,000 basic salary
- Uncapped / performance-related bonus structure
- Permanent position
- Monday to Friday office-based role
- Opportunity to join an established and respected business
- Excellent product and production capabilities
- Strong market reputation
- Genuine progression into a Business Development role
- Support from experienced senior commercial staff on meetings and larger opportunities

The Role

The successful candidate will be responsible for generating new business opportunities through proactive outbound sales activity.

This is a genuine new-business role and would suit someone who enjoys picking up the phone, speaking with decision-makers, qualifying opportunities and building a strong pipeline.

Initially, the focus will be on prospecting, lead generation and developing relationships from first contact. For larger opportunities, you will work closely with senior commercial colleagues who can support with client meetings, technical discussions, proposals and closing.

As you develop your knowledge and customer base, there will be scope to take greater ownership of the complete sales cycle and progress into a Business Development Manager position.

Key Responsibilities
- Making proactive outbound calls to prospective customers
- Identifying and targeting businesses with potential large-format print and visual communication requirements
- Building relationships with key decision-makers
- Generating and qualifying new business opportunities
- Developing opportunities through telephone, email and LinkedIn outreach
- Building and maintaining a strong pipeline of prospective customers
- Booking customer meetings for yourself and senior commercial colleagues
- Following up quotations, proposals and live opportunities
- Working closely with senior management to progress and close larger opportunities
- Approaching marketing teams, agencies, retailers, contractors, event businesses and other relevant organisations
- Understanding customer requirements and introducing suitable solutions
- Keeping CRM and pipeline information accurate and up to date
- Re-engaging previous customers and dormant accounts
- Identifying opportunities across new sectors and markets
- Converting prospects into profitable, long-term customers
- Achieving agreed activity, new-business and revenue targets

The Candidate

We are looking for an ambitious, confident and commercially driven sales professional who genuinely enjoys new-business development.

You do not necessarily need to have worked within large-format print previously, although experience within print, manufacturing, signage, packaging, marketing services or another B2 B environment would be advantageous.

The successful candidate will ideally have:
- Previous B2 B sales, internal sales, telesales or business development experience
- A genuine appetite for winning new business
- Confidence making outbound calls and approaching new organisations
- Strong communication skills and a natural ability to build rapport
- A proactive and resilient approach to sales
- Commercial awareness and the confidence to discuss customer requirements
- Strong follow-up and organisational skills
- A target-driven mindset
- The ability to work independently while also taking guidance from senior colleagues
- A desire to develop into a more senior Business Development position

This role could suit an experienced Internal Sales Executive, New Business Executive, Sales Executive, Business Development Executive or an ambitious Account Manager looking to move into a more proactive new-business position.

Streamline Search is a technical recruitment agency based in Chichester, West Sussex, operating across the United Kingdom. We are acting as a Recruitment Agency in relation to this vacancy and, in accordance with GDPR, by applying to this post you are granting us consent to process your data and contact you in relation to this application.

title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
Marketing Coordinator - UK and Europe

Location: Bradford, UK

Hours: Full Time

Reports to: Marketing Manager - US Corporate Office

Are you ready to take your marketing career to an international level?

Join our company, a successful US-headquartered manufacturer with a strong family-owned culture, ambitious growth plans and a genuine commitment to its people.

In this varied role, you will be part of our global Corporate Marketing team, supporting company-wide initiatives while also helping to shape marketing activity for the UK and Europe from our Bradford site.

You will have the opportunity to bring fresh ideas, take ownership of projects and make a visible contribution within a collaborative, values-led business where creativity, autonomy and global thinking are encouraged.

Role overview

We are looking for a Marketing Coordinator with a broad set of skills, a proactive approach and the ambition to develop with the business.

The role will involve conducting market research, analysing data, supporting business development activity and regional events, and creating localised promotional materials that clearly communicate how our products, manufacturing expertise, service, lead times and high-quality materials meet the needs of customers across the UK and Europe.

This role would suit someone who is comfortable working independently, taking ownership of tasks, and bringing creative, practical ideas to the team.

You will be organised, curious and self-motivated, with the confidence to work autonomously while staying well connected to colleagues across the wider global marketing function.

Responsibilities include:
- Conduct market research and qualify results to determine potential customers and competitors.
- Help develop and integrate our regional marketing presence in the EU and UK, as well as support broader business development and customer outreach efforts.
- Maintain and optimise customer relationship management database to segment customers for targeted promotional communications.
- Manage social media pages and ensure messaging is aligned with company guidelines.
- Create and deliver integrated campaigns for qualified prospects and existing customers.
- Develop marketing materials for specific market segments (e-mailers, technical bulletins, presentations, and handbooks) and related internal training documents to support best practices.
- Capture, create, and communicate market performance data (sales trends, account status, and website analytic reports) to sales team on a consistent basis.
- Coordinate logistics and sales support for trade shows, develop targeted marketing collateral, and research markets or additional event-specific promotional opportunities.
- Embrace TGC's strong culture of continuous improvement.

Skills and Experience

You will ideally bring:
- Degree-level education in marketing, business or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
- Previous experience in a marketing role, with exposure to campaign support, content creation, research, data analysis and internal or external communications.
- Strong written communication, organisation, research and data-management skills.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel.
- A good understanding of core marketing principles, audience segmentation, customer communications and the importance of consistent brand messaging.
- Clear written and spoken English.
- A self-motivated and organised approach, with the confidence to work autonomously, take ownership, collaborate with international colleagues and bring creative ideas forward.

It would also be beneficial if you have:
- An additional qualification in marketing, digital marketing, communications or design.
- Experience working within an international business and/or manufacturing environment across UK and European markets.
- Experience with HTML, CRM systems, Adobe Acrobat or other design, email marketing or digital content tools.
- Awareness of local business culture, European markets and basic technical or manufacturing terminology.
- Second-language skills, particularly German.
- A curious, proactive and adaptable approach, with an interest in continuous improvement and developing marketing activity in a growing international business.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a successful international business where you can develop your marketing experience across the UK and European markets while being part of a wider global Corporate Marketing team.

Apply today to take the next step in your marketing career with us

title: MEDICAL RECEPTIONIST

Action tasks on SystmOne Provide clerical assistance to support the delivery of patient services, e.g. post, data input and scanning. Specified Duties To provide and effective, polite and efficient point of contact to all patients and visitors to the Practice. Liaise with duty doctor via SystmOne any instructions regarding the processing of lists that are undertaken in line with the agreed procedure. Answer the telephone within 4 rings and ensure all messages are recorded in SystmOne and are dealt with or passed to the appropriate person for action. Deal with actions arising from the post when dealt with by the duty doctor. Deal with prescriptions requests and home visit requests as they come in, on the telephone and face to face. Liaise with other Health Care professionals, as and when necessary to ensure relevant people are advised of developments, which affect patients under their care. To work in a manner that ensures the smooth running of the Practice. Receiving and receipting monies. Using email facilities as an internal communication tool. At the end of the day ensure all areas of reception are tidy in order to ensure easy accessibility for the cleaners. To ensure all areas are secure at night, all electrical equipment is switched off and that the building is secure when last to leave. title: Project Administrator
description: JOB TITLE: Project Administrator REPORTS TO: Senior Project Manager, supported with training by all TPC Project Managers ACCOUNTABLE TO: TPC Chief Executive Officer HOURS: 37.5 hours per week - Permanent SALARY: £24,852.66 per annum We are recruiting for two positions within our team. (Note: TPC is not an Agenda for Change employer, but does offer the NHS Pension) JOB SUMMARY To provide high-quality administrative support to the West Yorkshire Primary Care Workforce & Training Hub, and other services hosted by Trust Primary Care Ltd. The role will be primarily based in Bradford, but you may have meetings across the West Yorkshire region if required, with potential for some remote working. Trust Primary Care Ltd (TPC) is a member organisation supporting and working together with 16 GP practices to deliver effective primary care services at scale. The role will support these various services run by the Federation, including specific project work, and standing administrative responsibilities for a range of projects. The ideal candidate will assist the operational team in maintaining robust processes and ensure compliance with relevant procedures and policies. As part of our growing Operational Team, the role will deliver the key objectives of TPC supporting and strengthening General Practice, providing at scale Primary Care services and being a voice of Primary Care in multi-agency working. DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES General Overview Support the project managers across allocated programmes and services ensuring processes, programmes and service information packs, guidance and associated documentation are accurate, current and relevant. Be the first point of contact for allocated programmes and services, responding to enquiries via phone and email, and appropriately signposting or escalating queries where required. Take responsibility for maintaining accurate and up-to-date records and supporting the completion of reports for ICBs, ICSs, national governing bodies and other external stakeholders, working alongside project managers and programme/service clinical leads as required Maintain programme trackers, action logs and any relevant spreadsheets to ensure deadlines and actions are monitored and escalated where required. Maintain accurate and appropriate records for each programme and service, including information relating to General Practices, PCNs, individuals and other relevant stakeholders Work closely with project managers to coordinate relevant administrative tasks, actions and associated activities to ensure all programmes and services are coordinated effectively and run smoothly. Liaise with external stakeholders including national governing bodies, ICBs, training providers, facilitators and other relevant organisations. Engage with General Practices and provide accurate and timely information to support workforce, education & training needs. Work collaboratively with other team members to provide effective cross-cover for the administration of programmes and services, as required. Coordinate training sessions, workshop and events, including bookings, venues, facilitators, attendance and associated administration. Attend and support external meetings, Connect Days, workshops, events and other activities as required. Support the coordination of meetings, including arranging meetings, preparing documentation, taking minutes and maintaining action logs, where required. Contribute to the development and review of SOPs, templates, guidance, website updates and administrative processes, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and consistency. Confidentiality Employees entrust us with, or allow us to gather, sensitive information in relation to their employment and other matters. They do so in confidence and have the right to expect that staff will respect their privacy and act appropriately. In the performance of the duties outlined in this job description, the post-holder may have access to confidential information relating to patients and their carers, TPC staff and other healthcare workers. They may also have access to information relating to TPC as a business organisation. All such information from any source is to be regarded as strictly confidential. Information relating to patients, carers, colleagues, other healthcare workers or the business of collaborating organisations may only be divulged to authorised persons in accordance with TPCs policies and procedures relating to confidentiality and the protection of personal and sensitive data. Health & Safety The post-holder will implement and lead on the full range of promotion and management of their own and others health, safety and security as defined in TPCs health & safety policy, health & safety manual, and infection control policy and published procedures. This will include (but will not be limited to): Ensure they adhere to their individual responsibilities for infection control and health and safety. Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of health and safety and infection control statutory and best practice guidelines. Using personal security systems within the workplace according to TPC guidelines. Identifying the risks involved in work activities and undertaking such activities in a way that manages those risks across the business. Making effective use of training to update knowledge and skills. Using appropriate infection control procedures, maintaining work areas in a tidy and safe way free from hazards, and initiation of remedial/corrective action where needed. Actively identifying, reporting, and correction of health and safety hazards and infection hazards immediately when recognised. Keeping own work areas and general/patient areas generally clean, identifying issues and hazards/risks in relation to other work areas within the business, and assuming responsibility in the maintenance of general standards of cleanliness across the organisation. Undertaking periodic infection control training (minimum annually). Routine management of own team/team areas, and maintenance of workspace standards. Demonstrate due regard for safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children. Equality and Diversity The post-holder will support the equality, diversity and rights of patients, carers, and colleagues, to include: Acting in a way that recognises the importance of peoples rights, interpreting them in a way that is consistent with TPC procedures and policies, and current legislation. Respecting the privacy, dignity, needs and beliefs of patients, carers, and colleagues. Behaving in a manner that is welcoming to and of the individual, is non-judgmental and respects their circumstances, feelings, priorities, and rights. Personal/professional development The post-holder will participate in any training programme implemented by TPC as part of this employment, such training, and responsibilities to include: To be responsible for the self-development of skills and competencies through participation in training and development activities and maintain up to date technical and professional knowledge relevant to the post. To undertake any identified training and development related to the post and undertake statutory and mandatory training as deemed appropriate by TPC. Participation in an annual individual performance review, including taking responsibility for maintaining a record of own personal and/or professional development. Taking responsibility for own development, learning and performance and demonstrating skills and activities to others who are undertaking similar work. Quality The post-holder will strive to maintain quality within TPC, and will: Alert other team members to issues of quality and risk. Assess own performance and take accountability for own actions, either directly or under supervision. Contribute to the effectiveness of the team by reflecting on own and team activities and making suggestions on ways to improve and enhance the teams performance. Work effectively with individuals in other agencies to meet patients needs. Effectively manage own time, workload, and resources. Communication The post-holder should recognise the importance of effective communication within the team and will strive to: Communicate effectively with other team members. Communicate effectively with patients and carers. Recognise peoples needs for alternative methods of communication and respond accordingly. Contribution to the implementation of services The post-holder will: Apply TPCs policies, standards, and guidance. Discuss with other members of the team how the policies, standards and guidelines will affect own work. Participate in audit where appropriate. Development The post-holder will engage and participate in any opportunities arising within the development and expansion of the organisation. Flexibility This job description is not intended to be exhaustive. The post-holder will be expected to adopt a flexible attitude towards the duties outlined which may be subject to amendment at any time in line with the needs of the organisation. The post holder may be required to fulfil other duties, as agreed with their line managers, to meet the needs of the organisation. This will involve travel to other sites within the organisation.
